name: @pipeworx/mcp-tarot

tools.name: random_card
tools.description: Draws one random card from the Pipeworx original 78-card tarot deck (Rider–Waite–Smith tradition). Returns the card, its orientation (upright or reversed, a coin-flip unless disabled), the traditional meaning for that orientation, and the seed used to reproduce the draw.

seed.description: Reproduce a previous draw by passing back the seed it returned. Omit for fresh randomness.

reversals.description: Allow reversed orientation (50% chance per card). Default true; pass false to always draw upright.

session_id.description: Draw from an open tarot_shuffle session instead of a fresh single-call draw (hosted only; never repeats a card within the session).

tools.name: draw_cards
tools.description: Draws a spread of 1–78 random cards from the Pipeworx original tarot deck (Rider–Waite–Smith tradition), each with its own orientation and traditional meaning for that orientation.

seed.description: Reproduce a previous draw by passing back the seed it returned. Omit for fresh randomness.

reversals.description: Allow reversed orientation (50% chance per card). Default true; pass false to always draw upright.

session_id.description: Draw from an open tarot_shuffle session instead of a fresh single-call draw (hosted only; never repeats a card within the session).

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Searches the Pipeworx original tarot deck by name, suit, or keyword — matches against card names, both orientations’ keywords and meanings, and suit.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (e.g. "moon", "strength", "cups", "betrayal").

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Looks up one card from the Pipeworx original tarot deck by its id (e.g. "major_00", "wands_01") or its exact name (e.g. "The Fool"). Returns both upright and reversed meanings as reference, plus keywords and the image description.

name_short.description: Card id ("major_00".."major_21", "wands_01".."pentacles_14") or exact card name (e.g. "The Fool", "Ace of Wands").

tools.name: tarot_spread
tools.description: Deals a named layout from the Pipeworx original tarot deck (Rider–Waite–Smith tradition): three_card, situation_obstacle_advice, celtic_cross, horseshoe, yes_no, or a custom set of positions. Each position gets its own card, orientation, and traditional meaning for that orientation. `question` is echoed back verbatim — this tool never interprets it.

positions.description: Required when spread is "custom": the ordered list of position labels (max 20).

question.description: The question this spread is being read for. Echoed back verbatim, never interpreted.

reversals.description: Allow reversed orientation per card (50% chance). Default true.

seed.description: Reproduce a previous spread by passing back the seed it returned. Omit for fresh randomness.

session_id.description: Deal from an open tarot_shuffle session instead of a fresh deal (hosted only; never repeats a card within the session).

tools.name: tarot_shuffle
tools.description: Opens (or reshuffles) a stateful 78-card tarot session on the Pipeworx original deck, so later random_card/draw_cards/tarot_spread calls with the same session_id draw without repeating a card until the session is reshuffled or expires (24h). Hosted only — a standalone/npm build returns session_supported:false.

session_id.description: Reshuffle this existing session instead of opening a new one.

seed.description: Deterministic shuffle order. Omit for fresh randomness.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tarot forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tarot pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
